en.name: English
en.hintRotate: Drag to turn. What can you see?
en.stageHint: Drag to turn, spread to open, tap a seed.
en.noWebGL: Try the picture below. You can still open the fruit and find its seeds.
en.treeHint: Give the tree a little shake. Then choose a fruit.
en.title: Hello, little orange.
en.subtitle: A round little fruit. A juicy surprise inside.

facts.title: Peel and pith
facts.text: A bumpy peel with soft white pith beneath.

facts.title: Segments
facts.text: Juicy sections fit together like little wedges.

facts.title: Seeds
facts.text: Some oranges have seeds. Others have none!

story.title: First, a blossom
story.text: A flower can become a tiny orange.

story.title: Round and growing
story.text: The little orange grows bigger on its branch.

story.title: To the kitchen
story.text: A grown-up can wash it and help you peel it.

en.origin: Orange trees grow in many warm places around the world.
en.modelNote: Five seeds to find in this play model. Real oranges can have more, fewer, or no seeds.

ko.name: 한국어
ko.stageHint: 밀어서 돌리고, 벌려서 열고, 씨앗을 눌러요.
ko.noWebGL: 아래 그림으로 놀아봐요. 과일을 벌리고 씨앗을 찾을 수 있어요.
ko.treeHint: 나무를 살짝 흔들어봐요. 그리고 과일을 골라요.
ko.title: 안녕, 작은 오렌지야.
ko.subtitle: 동글동글 작은 과일 속에 촉촉한 비밀이 있어요.

facts.title: 껍질과 흰 속껍질
facts.text: 울퉁불퉁한 껍질 아래 부드러운 흰 부분이 있어요.

facts.title: 씨앗
facts.text: 씨앗이 있는 오렌지도, 없는 오렌지도 있어요!

story.title: 먼저 꽃이 피어요
story.text: 꽃에서 작은 오렌지가 생길 수 있어요.

ko.origin: 오렌지나무는 세계 여러 따뜻한 곳에서 자라요.
ko.modelNote: 이 놀이 모형에는 씨앗이 5개 있어요. 실제 오렌지는 씨가 더 많거나 적을 수 있고, 없을 수도 있어요.

es.name: Español
es.stageHint: Arrastra para girar, separa para abrir y toca una semilla.
es.noWebGL: Prueba el dibujo de abajo. Puedes abrir la fruta y buscar sus semillas.
es.treeHint: Mueve un poco el árbol. Después elige una fruta.
es.title: Hola, pequeña naranja.
es.subtitle: Una fruta redondita. Una sorpresa jugosa dentro.

facts.title: Cáscara y capa blanca
facts.text: Bajo la cáscara rugosa hay una capa blanca y esponjosa.

facts.title: Gajos
facts.text: Los gajos jugosos encajan como pequeñas cuñas.

facts.title: Semillas
facts.text: ¡Hay naranjas con semillas y otras sin ellas!

story.title: Primero, una flor
story.text: Una flor puede convertirse en una naranja.

story.title: Redondita y creciendo
story.text: La naranja se hace más grande en su rama.

story.title: A la cocina
story.text: Una persona adulta puede lavarla y ayudarte a pelarla.

es.origin: Los naranjos crecen en muchos lugares cálidos del mundo.
es.modelNote: Busca cinco semillas en este modelo de juego. Las naranjas reales pueden tener más, menos o ninguna.
